achievement.1.description: Imate oko za sumnjiva mjesta i volite čitati tuđe dnevnike, posebno one sa vampirskim pričama. Takođe ste posvećeni sakupljač žetona i istraživač. Respect!
achievement.1.name: [EN] Castlemania
achievement.10.description: Vi slijedite put snova i put odgovornosti bez egocentrične moći. Oslobođeni pohlepe i sebičnosti, pomažete drugima ne očekujući nagradu.
achievement.10.name: [EN] Nightmare Knight
achievement.100.description: Malo stvari je jednako divljem bijesu zarobljenog i raskidanog stvorenja. Bio si dostojan protivnik.
achievement.100.name: Ubica Irahsae
achievement.101.description: Slijepa mržnja poprimila je fizički oblik, nasilno se pobunila protiv nepravde u kojoj je rođena. Niste bili u stanju donijeti pravdu - ali barem privremeni mir.
achievement.101.name: Ubica Phrodoma
achievement.102.description: Zabranjeno znanje eona nikada nije trebalo da napadne ovaj svijet. Utišali ste njegov glas prije nego što se mogao čuti.
achievement.102.name: Ubica Tenešpara
achievement.103.description: Pomogao si da se sruše Devovorgini opasni pipci i njena ogromna čahura - ne zaustavivši njenu transformaciju, ali na kraju dovršivši ključni korak do njene smrti.
achievement.103.name: [EN] Cocoon of Doom
achievement.104.description: Jedan poseban heroj među mnogima. Ove godine - to si bio ti. Devovorga se povukla u mračnije carstvo jer nije mogla izdržati tvoju moć - i moć tvojih drugova. Vrijeme će pokazati da li je vaš izbor bio dobar - ali za sada vam je spasio svijet.
achievement.104.name: [EN] Devovorga's Nemesis
achievement.105.description: Umoran... tako umoran... sklupčanje u toplom i udobnom krevetu izgleda kao savršena stvar za sada. Slatki snovi!
achievement.105.name: [EN] Mister Sandman
achievement.106.description: Spavanje - radite to sa stilom. Odmarate se u svojoj visećoj mreži, slušate zvuk ptica i cvrčaka dok se polako udaljavate u carstvo snova.
achievement.106.name: [EN] Rock Me to Sleep
achievement.107.description: Ne treba vam mnogo da biste spavali udobno. Gomila slame i krov nad glavom - s tim da ovo drugo nije obavezno - sasvim su dovoljni za opuštanje. Čak vam ne smeta što vam pacovi grickaju prste.
achievement.107.name: [EN] Modest Guest
achievement.108.description: Pa – sadržaj tog poklona nije bio baš ono što ste očekivali. Sa ovakvim prijateljima, kome trebaju neprijatelji?
achievement.108.name: Šala na tebe
achievement.109.description: Toliko o tvom malom pernatom prijatelju! Možda stajati ispred kaveza za ptice, stiskati mu vrat i vičući 'Pjevajte! Pevaj! Pjevaj!' je bilo malo previše za to?!
achievement.109.name: Ups
achievement.11.description: Pridružili ste se nemrtvoj braći po kostima - čineći smrt svojim neprijateljem i oružjem. Progutati ono što je slabo i ostaviti prostora za ono što je jako vaš je primarni cilj.
achievement.11.name: [EN] Bone Brother
achievement.110.description: Živite životom lovaca i sakupljača. Pa, posebno berača, a posebno onog koji bere mnogo borovnica. Jeste li u posljednje vrijeme provjerili boju svog jezika?
achievement.110.name: Bluebarian
achievement.111.description: Gusta, crvena - protresena, ne mešana - i sa slamčicom u sebi: to je način na koji više voliš svoju demonsku krv. Poslužen s kolutićem luka, suptilni metalni okus se gotovo i ne primjećuje. Blagotvorni efekti na zdravlje ili manu su dobrodošli.
achievement.111.name: Demonski Barkeeper
achievement.112.description: Voliš zimu. Potpuno opremljen šalom i rukavicama, volite da se zabavljate napolju dok pravite puno snjegovića sa svojim prijateljima. Borba grudama, bilo ko?
achievement.112.name: [EN] The Snowman
achievement.113.name: Broj zveri
achievement.114.description: Ti i tvoji plišani krzneni prijatelji ste nerazdvojni, i nije vas sramota da ih odvedete u krevet sa sobom - ko zna kada ćete se probuditi usred noći da vam je prijeko potrebno maženje?
achievement.114.name: Treba mi zagrljaj
achievement.115.description: U redu, da se razumijemo - sve dok vjerujete da bi vas to potencijalno moglo dovesti do najvećeg blaga ikada, nećete pustiti tu mapu, koliko god ona izgledala sumnjivo. Mora da postoji tajna iza svega ovoga!
achievement.115.name: [EN] Slim Chance
achievement.116.description: Ili ne učite brzo ili vam je zadovoljstvo da se zapalite. Ili samo tražite fensi naslov. U svakom slučaju, treba da znate da se ne preporučuje ispuštanje gasova tokom eksperimenata sa malim magarčićem.
achievement.116.name: Raketa u džepu
achievement.117.description: Ali zatvorite oči i ne govorite nikome šta ste poželeli, inače vam se neće ostvariti!
achievement.117.name: Poželi želju
achievement.118.description: Božić je tvoje omiljeno doba godine, a momče, da li voliš poklone. Kupite neke lijepe stvari za svoje prijatelje, sakrijte ih dok - pa, dok ne odlučite da ih sami odmotate.
achievement.118.name: Deda Mrazov mali pomoćnik
achievement.119.description: Gnjev štetnog spawn-a - slučajno ste ga uspjeli navući. Vaši dani se broje i smrt je neizbježna. Nekad. Negdje.
achievement.119.name: Cursed!
achievement.12.description: Proputovali ste svijet zbog gotovo besmislene molitve - ali barem to ne morate činiti ponovo i možete dobiti novi blagoslovljeni kolac u tren oka.
achievement.12.name: Blagoslovljeno!
achievement.120.description: Bravo! Nalaznici čuvari, gubitnici plačući! Koga briga odakle su sve te stvari i da li ste morali da puzite kroz gomile smeća da biste ih dobili? BESPLATNO je!
achievement.120.name: Besplatni artikli!
achievement.121.description: Gore i dolje i gore i dolje... i onda velika petlja! Čekaj - oni ne prave petlje u Kazordoonu. Ali vožnje vagonima za rude i dalje su zabavne!
achievement.121.name: [EN] Rollercoaster
achievement.122.description: Vi ste, gospodine ili gospođo, pravi alhemičar. Provođenje eksperimenata transmutacije kako biste pronašli svaku moguću kombinaciju vaša je tajna strast već godinama, a rezultati vašeg istraživanja su nevjerovatni. Nauka je upravo napravila skok zahvaljujući vama!
achievement.122.name: [EN] Transmutator
achievement.123.description: RAWR! Snaga prolazi kroz vaše tijelo, vaše srce radi brže, a adrenalin pokreće svaki vaš zamah oružja. Sve u maloj boci. Nema povrata za uništeni namještaj. Za dodatna pitanja obratite se svom iscjelitelju ili prodavaču napitaka.
achievement.123.name: Berserker
achievement.124.description: Osjećate da možete riješiti najteže zagonetke u roku od jedne minute. Osim toga, postoji lijepo povećanje štete od uroka. Sve u maloj boci. Posljedice - osjećam se pomalo glupo. Za dodatna pitanja obratite se svom iscjelitelju ili prodavaču napitaka.
achievement.124.name: Mastermind
achievement.125.description: Poboljšan vid, strijele i vijci koji lete brzinom svjetlosti i pribadaju vaše neprijatelje dodatnom štetom. Sve u maloj boci. Nije potrebna konzumacija šargarepe. Za dodatna pitanja obratite se svom iscjelitelju ili prodavaču napitaka.
achievement.125.name: [EN] Sharpshooter
achievement.126.description: Urgh! Zatvori prozore! Ugasite sunce koje diže svoju ružnu žutu glavu, isključite uši smeh korpulentne dece vašeg komšije. Ahhh. Zagrli slatku tamu i tišinu.
achievement.126.name: Ne ometaj
achievement.127.description: Ustani i zablistaj! Predivan je novi dan - otvorite prozore, osjetite toplu sunčevu svjetlost, gledajte ptice kako pjevaju na vašoj prozorskoj dasci i pazite na svoje biljke. Koji razlog postoji da ne budete srećni?
achievement.127.name: Pustite Sunce unutra
achievement.128.description: Argh! Ne sada! Kako to da ti multifunkcionalni alati nikada ne pokvare kada ih koristite za nešto potpuno trivijalno kao što je cijeđenje soka, ali zabrljate kada očajnički trebate da se popnete na konopac sa zmajem koji diše vatru koji vas juri?
achievement.128.name: Bad Timing
achievement.129.description: Smijete se nespremnim avanturistima zaglavljenima u visokoj travi ili rogoza. Ili im možda zaista pomažete. Zovu te... 'Mačeta'.
achievement.129.name: Ništa me ne može zaustaviti
achievement.13.description: Vi ste talentovani trgovac koji je u stanju da pažljivo rukuje robom, pronalazi dobre ponude i s vremena na vreme iskopava retke. Nikada ne kasnite da završite narudžbu, vi ste pouzdan trgovac - barem u Rašidovim očima.
achievement.13.name: Recognized Trader
achievement.130.description: Kosa vam je prešla preko ramena, a sunce vam peče po leđima - u duši ste seljak i volite raditi u polju. Ili opet možda samo kreirate otmjene krugove u žitu kako biste uplašili svoje bližnje.
achievement.130.name: [EN] Happy Farmer
achievement.131.description: Liberty Bay je savršeno mjesto za vas, a berba šećerne trske je prilično opuštajuća aktivnost u slobodno vrijeme. Hoćeš li čaja sa šećerom, dušo?
achievement.131.name: Prirodni zaslađivač
achievement.132.description: Yo-ho-ho i boca ruma - domaći, naravno, napravljen od ručno ubranih i lično ubranih biljaka šećerne trske. Sada ga ostavite da odleži u hrastovoj bačvi i uživajte u njemu za oko 10 godina. Ili za one nestrpljive: Hajdemo odmah na paaaarty!
achievement.132.name: Homebrewed
achievement.133.description: Skrivena blaga ispod pješčanih dina pustinje - imate nos da ih pronađete i znate gdje kopati. Možda vas neće učiniti prljavo bogatim, ali su sjajne i lijepe u svakom slučaju.
achievement.133.name: [EN] Gold Digger
achievement.134.description: Ti i tvoja lopata - šibica napravljena na nebu. Ili pakao, što se toga tiče. U svakom slučaju negdje dolje. Čarobno vas privlače kamene gomile i volite ih otvoriti i vidjeti kuda vas te rupe vode. Dobri bicepsi takođe.
achievement.134.name: Undertaker
achievement.135.description: Svako vas može lako pronaći ako samo slijedi trag mrvica kolačića. A za vas prava ljubav znači da poklonite svoj poslednji kolačić.
achievement.135.name: [EN] Cookie Monster
achievement.136.description: A svako ko tvrdi suprotno je lažov.
achievement.136.name: Torta je istina
achievement.137.description: Čuvenu 'Odu otopljenoj čokoladnoj torti' ste vjerovatno napisali vi. Provesti kišno popodne ispred dimnjaka, umotani u ćebe dok se prepuštate kakao užicima, zvuči kao nešto što biste radili. Enjoy!
achievement.137.name: [EN] Sweet Tooth
achievement.138.description: Volite da je vaša torta mekana, sa voćnim komadićima i finom šećernom glazurom. I radije ih pravite sami. Da li ste ikada razmišljali o otvaranju pekare? Mora da ste do sada stvarno dobri!
achievement.138.name: Sa trešnjom na vrhu
achievement.139.description: Muahahaha to je... mutirana bundeva! Nakon što ste pomogli da ga skinete - JESTE li pomogli, zar ne? - uzeli ste svoju nagradu i dobili manje-više čudan poklon. Sretna Noć vještica!
achievement.139.name: [EN] Mutated Presents
achievement.14.description: Našli ste i otpili gutljaj iz Fontane Života. Mislio da vam ne daje vječni život, osjećate se promijenjenim i nekako u miru.
achievement.14.name: Fontana života
achievement.140.description: Jedan od Svetlonoša. Jedan od onih koji su pomogli da se bazeni održe gore i zajedno su radili protiv tame. Demonski šapat iza tankog vela između svjetova - opet su utihnuli zahvaljujući vašoj pomoći.
achievement.140.name: Čuvar plamena
achievement.141.description: Vi ste jedan od najposvećenijih Svetlonoša - bez vas, demoni bi sigurno pocepali veo između svetova. Zapalili ste svaki umivaonik, putujući visoko i nisko, potiskujući vanzemaljske sile. Neka bude svjetlost!
achievement.141.name: [EN] True Lightbearer
achievement.142.description: Pobijedili ste inkarnacije Boga zmija i posljednjim snažnim zamahom zmijskog žezla, prekinuli ste njegovu životnu snagu. Priči o moći, prevari i korupciji došao je kraj - ili... ne?
achievement.142.name: Godslayer
achievement.143.description: Uhm... ko je ta osoba pored koje si se upravo probudio? Razbijene čaše za koktel na podu, cvijeće po cijeloj prostoriji, a zašto, dovraga, nosiš prsten? Jučerašnji dan mora da je bio dug, čudan dan...
achievement.143.name: Dan poslije
achievement.144.description: Dugoročne veze jednostavno nisu za vas. I svaki put kada pomislite da ste zaljubljeni, ubrzo nakon toga se pokaže da niste u pravu. Ili možda jednostavno svaki put završite s pogrešnim ljubavnikom - iskorištavanim i izdanim. Možda bi bilo bolje ostati samac.
achievement.144.name: Predanost fobika
achievement.145.description: Poverenje? Ljubav? Vjernost? Pah! Zastarjeli osjećaji. Sve dok se zabavljate, nemate ništa protiv da zgazite puno srca. Po mogućnosti dok nosite borbene čizme.
achievement.145.name: [EN] Heartbreaker
achievement.146.description: Stealth ubistva i ubadanje u leđa su vaša specijalnost. Vaše brojne žrtve obično nisu svjesne svoje neposredne smrti, koju im donosite tiho i brzo. Sve je dozvoljeno.
achievement.146.name: Brza smrt
achievement.147.description: Šta je najbolje u životu? Da slomi svoje neprijatelje. Da ih vidite kako voze prije vas. I da možda posle popijem šoljicu lepog čaja.
achievement.147.name: [EN] Brutal Politeness
achievement.148.description: Ti si prosjak, beskućnik, nosiš prljavu i pohabanu odjeću. Ali to ne znači da morate moliti bilo koga za stvari - a i dalje ste zadržali svoj ponos. Fino perje ne čini nužno fine ptice - važnije je ono što je ispod njih.
achievement.148.name: Život na ulicama
achievement.149.description: Noseći oznake i tamne haljine Bratstva kostiju lutate zemljama šireći strah i bol, stvarajući nove vojnike za nekromantičku vojsku koja će uskoro ustati. Pozdrav Bratstvu.
achievement.149.name: Lobanja i kosti
achievement.15.description: Proputovali ste nadrealno carstvo elementarnih sfera, prizvali i ubili Gospodara elemenata, sve da biste povratili neutralnu materiju. I koliko god bili hrabri, to ne biste mogli bez svog tima!
achievement.15.name: Gospodar elemenata
achievement.150.description: Ne plašite se noćnih mora, vi putujete u njima - suočavajući se sa bezbrojnim užasima i boreći se sa sudbinom koju će vam doneti. Malo tko vjeruje u mračna proročanstva koja izvlačite iz tih snova, ali oni koji se bore uz vas kao vitezovi noćnih mora.
achievement.150.name: [EN] Nightmare Walker
achievement.151.description: Svaki grad bi trebao biti ponosan što nekoga poput vas naziva svojim stanovnikom. Održavate čiste ulice i pomažete u rješavanju uobičajenih sporova ispred depoa. Također, vjerovatno posjedujete mačku i volite planinarenje.
achievement.151.name: Uzorni građanin
achievement.152.description: Taj kolac ne nosite samo za ukras - spremni ste ga koristiti. Obično se može vidjeti kako se krećete kroz najdublje tamnice ostavljajući trag ubijenih demona. Ko god se usudi da vam stane na put neka se pripremi da umre.
achievement.152.name: Demonbane
achievement.153.description: Jedan sa prirodom, jedan sa divljim životinjama. Sirova i životinjska moć, izoštrena čula, zavijanje na najvišim liticama i urlanje u najgušćim šumama - to ste vi.
achievement.153.name: Vukova i medveda
achievement.154.description: Danju možete biti zatečeni u šumi kako postavljate zamke ili jurite krupnu divljač, a noću sjedite kraj logorske vatre i dijelite svoje lovačke priče. Jedete ono što ste lovili i nosite ono što ste ogulili. Život bi mogao tako da traje zauvek.
achievement.154.name: Lov sa stilom
achievement.155.description: I zapamtite: nikada ne pokušavajte da naučite svinju da pjeva. To gubi vaše vrijeme i nervira svinju.
achievement.155.name: Budala u srcu
achievement.156.description: Sa oštricom i potpuno opremljenim čvrstim oklopom od punog ploča, napadate svoje neprijatelje i snagom i hrabrošću. Uvijek postoji djevojka koju treba spasiti i zmaj da ubiješ za tebe.
achievement.156.name: U sjajnom oklopu
achievement.157.description: Dan započinjete kupanjem u svom loncu sa zlatom i nemate ništa protiv da pokažete svoje bogatstvo dok šetate ulicama u svojoj najboljoj odjeći – na kraju krajeva, to je vaš teško zarađeni novac! Više volite da vam se obraćaju sa 'Vaše Visočanstvo'.
achievement.157.name: Aristokrata
achievement.158.description: Snježne gomile i tuče ne mogu vas spriječiti tamo gdje želite. Savršeno ste opremljeni za bilo koju ekspediciju u vječni led i znate kako zagrijati stopala. Ako ste žena, i to je veliki uspjeh.
achievement.158.name: Napolju u snježnoj oluji
achievement.159.description: Osjećate se kao kod kuće pod vrelim pustinjskim suncem s pijeskom između nožnih prstiju, a vaše omiljeno sredstvo putovanja je leteći tepih. Također, vjerovatno možete napraviti taj plesni pokret za izolaciju glave.
achievement.159.name: Hiljadu i jedan
achievement.16.description: Ponovo ste odigrali Ukroćenje goropadnice na plaži i dokazali da se prilično dobro nosite s hirovitim djevojkama. Sa ili bez ribljih repova.
achievement.16.name: [EN] Beach Tamer
achievement.160.description: Budite džentlmen o bogatstvu, borite se i vrtite se na otvorenom moru, izvlačite plijen i devojke! Ne odgovarajte nikome ili prokletoj monarhiji i vaš život nije pun ljiljana. Da, druže!
achievement.160.name: [EN] Swashbuckler
achievement.161.description: Tresanje zvečke i ples oko vatre uz bubnjeve iz džungle zvuči kao nešto što volite raditi. Osim toga, dredovi su zgodan način nošenja kose - nije potrebno češljanje!
achievement.161.name: Put šamana
achievement.162.description: Mogli biste biti autor magnum opusa 'Kako prizvati ultimativnu zvijer iz paklenih dubina, tom I'. Ili, ako su vam um i srce čisti, radije prizivate bića da pomognu drugima. Ili možda samo malu mačku da ima nekoga da se mazi.
achievement.162.name: Ritualist
achievement.163.description: Ne plašite se pokazati svoje boje u žaru bitke. Neprijatelji se boje vašeg smrtonosnog koplja i neprobojnog oklopa. Lista ratova koje ste dobili je impresivna. Pozdrav i ubij!
achievement.163.name: Majstor rata
achievement.164.description: Hrabrost je za slabiće - nije važno kako ćete dobiti bitku, sve dok ste pobjednici. Debeli oklop bi samo ometao vaše pokrete, tako da ga održavate laganim i oslanjate se na brzinu i vještinu umjesto da se skrivate u neudobnoj školjki.
achievement.164.name: [EN] Wild Warrior
achievement.165.description: Vi ste skromni ratnik kome nije potrebno bogatstvo ili specijalizovana oprema za putovanja i borbu. Osjećate se kao kod kuće u sjevernim zemljama Zaoa i dali ste svoj dio u borbi protiv njegove korupcije.
achievement.165.name: [EN] Peazzekeeper
achievement.166.description: Vaša djela za Yalahara obično karakterišu duboki uvid i promišljene akcije. Zahvaljujući vama, Yalahar bi mogao imati priliku da raste mirno i sa sretnim ljudima koji žive u njemu.
achievement.166.name: Yalahari mudrosti
achievement.167.description: Vi branite Yalahar grubom silom i spremni ste da ga povedete u veličanstvenu bitku, ako je potrebno. Zahvaljujući vama, Yalahar će biti dovoljno moćan da se suprotstavi svakom neprijatelju.
achievement.167.name: Yalahari moći
achievement.168.description: Život može biti tako lak s pravom tortom u pravo vrijeme - a savladali ste pečenje mnogo različitih, tako da biste trebali biti spremni na gotovo sve što vam život odluči baciti.
achievement.168.name: [EN] Piece of Cake
achievement.169.description: Smatrate se prvorazrednim diplomantom Magijske akademije u Edronu zbog vaših pionirskih otkrića i uspješnih studija u polju eksperimentalne magije i razvoja uroka. Jeste li ikada razmišljali o podučavanju čarolije Armagedon?
achievement.169.name: Alumni
achievement.17.description: Kada nešto uradite, uradite to kako treba. Imate mišljenje i ostajete pri njemu - i niko vas neće moći uvjeriti u suprotno. S druge strane, vi ste pomalo brutalni i ratno orijentisani, ali to nije loše, zar ne?
achievement.17.name: Sljedbenik Azerusa
achievement.170.description: Vješt ste u mračnijim načinima magije i obično se nađete kako sjedite u krugu svijeća i lubanja mrmljajući neizrecive riječi. Ne nosite stvari predaleko ili bi vas demoni mogli uhvatiti.
achievement.170.name: Warlock
achievement.171.description: Zaista, ne volite zečeve. Možda će zečevi koje ste spasili danas biti zečevi koji će vas spasiti sutra. Kada ste zaista gladni.
achievement.171.name: [EN] Bunny Slipped
achievement.172.description: Pravi naučnici poznaju svoju opremu. Testiranje novih izuma je neophodan svakodnevni posao za svakog vrijednog istraživača. Niste pokazivali strah i uzeli ste svu novu opremu od Spectulusa i Sinclair-a.
achievement.172.name: Zamorac
achievement.173.description: Otišli ste u šumu, upoznali Rottin Wood i oženjene muškarce i pomogli im u njihovom kampu. Oh, i ne brini za te trgovce. Neće se usuditi da spomenu čudno velike količine zlata koje su zapravo posjedovali, a koje sada nedostaje.
achievement.173.name: [EN] Merry Adventures
achievement.174.description: Prošao si njihov test i pomogao Spirithunters-ima da testiraju opremu, istražuju natprirodno i hvataju duhove - tebe će pozvati.
achievement.174.name: Ne bojim se duhova!
achievement.175.description: Gotovo sve biljke koje ste testirali na Chartan u Zaou su nejestive - sve ste ih probali, a ipak stojite! Ipak, sada bi zaista trebao izaći na svjež zrak.
achievement.175.name: [EN] Extreme Degustation
achievement.176.description: Hrabro ste zakoračili na ostrvo kolača. Ima li ljepšeg, ukusnijeg mjesta na cijelom svijetu?
achievement.176.name: [EN] Cake Conqueror
achievement.177.description: Razveselili ste demonsku bebu i vratili je majci. Brzo prebrojavanje vaših prstiju će otkriti jeste li uspjeli proći neozlijeđeni.
achievement.177.name: [EN] Baby Sitter
achievement.178.description: Razveselili ste gomilu demonskih beba i vratili ih njihovoj majci. Ne gnjavi tragove opekotina, ne smetaj sijede kose, ne smetaj noćima kada se budiš vrišteći. Vrijedilo je... vjerovatno... nekako.
achievement.178.name: Dadilja iz pakla
achievement.179.description: Plovili ste donjim morima sa Kapetanom duhova. Uprkos opasnostima, vi i vaše kolege iz posade hrabro ste se suočili sa izazovom.
achievement.179.name: [EN] Ghost Sailor
achievement.18.description: Ti si mirotvorac i slušaj šta mali ljudi imaju da kažu. Odlučili ste se i znate kome da pomognete i iz kojih razloga - i to radite dosljedno. Vaš rat se vodi razumom, a ne oružjem.
achievement.18.name: Sljedbenik Palimuta
achievement.180.description: Nekoliko puta ste plovili donjim morima sa Kapetanom duhova. Opasnosti donjeg svijeta postale su vam poznate i neiskusni putnici se obraćaju vama za savjet.
achievement.180.name: Spectral Traveler
achievement.181.description: Ne plašeći se smrti ili duhova, putovali ste sa kapetanom duhova nekoliko puta i iskusni ste putnik u podzemlje. Mrtvi i živi šapuću o vašim podvizima sa zahvalnošću.
achievement.181.name: [EN] Nether Pirate
achievement.182.description: Vi ste gospodar donjeg mora i putovali ste sa kapetanom duhova toliko puta da znate njegov brod i opasnosti donjeg mora iznutra. Smijete se u lice smrti i možda se i sami vratite kao gusar duh u zagrobnom životu!
achievement.182.name: [EN] Scourge of Death
achievement.183.description: Pomogli ste u održavanju vještičje vatre. Samo pazi na prste, vruće je!
achievement.183.name: [EN] Fire Lighter
achievement.184.description: Žrtvovali ste sastojke kako biste stvorili zaštitni napitak vještica.
achievement.184.name: Vještice Lil' Helper
achievement.185.description: Žrtvovali ste mnogo sastojaka kako biste stvorili zaštitni napitak od vještica i igrali značajnu ulogu u naporima da se odbiju zastrašujuće banebringers. Nedostatak je u tome što vas čak i oni koji donose proklinjanje mogu primijetiti...
achievement.185.name: [EN] Banebringers' Bane
achievement.186.description: Da biste zadržali vještičju vatru, uništili ste mnogo drva koje su donosioci propasti animirali. Nekima bi vaša fascinacija vatrom mogla biti... uznemirujuća.
achievement.186.name: Fire Devil
achievement.187.description: Ljubav... vatra! Tako... sjajno! Mora ... buuuurrrrn!
achievement.187.name: Pyromaniac
achievement.188.description: Vaši napori da se borite protiv benebringera nisu ostali nezapaženi. Ti si legenda među vješticama i tvoje ime se šapuće sa strahopoštovanjem i divljenjem.
achievement.188.name: [EN] Honorary Witch
achievement.189.description: Oh, radost jahanja! Upravo ste dobili svog prvog vlastitog konja. Dovoljno je zgodno da vam čak i ne trebaju štale, ali možete je pozvati kad god želite.
achievement.189.name: [EN] Natural Born Cowboy
achievement.19.description: Uskačete u svaku priliku za lovački izazov koji vam se nudi i izvršavate te zadatke sa smrtonosnom preciznošću. Vi ste lovac u srcu i vrijedan član Društva za šape i krzno.
achievement.19.name: Elitni lovac
achievement.190.description: Kamenje vas je oduvijek fasciniralo. Dakle, ima priliku pronaći nešto zaista dragocjeno u jednom od njih. Statistički gledano, do sada ste trebali otkriti nekoliko lijepih blaga. Ali opet, većinu statistike nadjačava Majka Nesreća.
achievement.190.name: [EN] Petrologist
achievement.191.description: Otkrili ste skrivene moći Drevnih - od sada će vam one pomagati u vašim avanturama.
achievement.191.name: Skrivene moći
achievement.192.description: Definitivno znate kako da izvučete najbolje iz svog namještaja i ukrasnih komada. Beautiful.
achievement.192.name: Sviđa mi se Fancy
achievement.193.description: Svoj nož od opsidijana uvijek nosite sa sobom i nećete oklevati da ga koristite. Ogulili ste kožu bezbroj malih - i većih - stvorenja i da: obično ne postaju ljepše iznutra. Prilično je krv i krv i sve to...
achievement.193.name: Skin-Deep
achievement.194.description: Probijanje vampira i demona gotovo se pretvorilo u vašu profesiju. Pobrinite se da skupite i najmanju količinu zlih čestica prašine. Čuvajte se silikoze.
achievement.194.name: Pepeo u prah
achievement.196.description: Ne brinite, niko vam to neće moći uzeti. Vjerovatno.
achievement.196.name: Sigurno pohranjeno
achievement.197.name: Nešto je unutra
achievement.198.description: Awww. Tvoj mali prijatelj zlatne ribice - sladak je, sjajan je i ne može se požaliti ako ga zaboraviš nahraniti. Definitivno će vam uljepšati dan!
achievement.198.name: Silent Pet
achievement.199.description: Skakanje, skakanje kroz snijeg - to je najsmješniji način! Pravljenje otisaka stopala u naletu - zabavnije je što više žurite! Lizanje ledenica cijeli dan - Zima, nikad ne odlazi!
achievement.199.name: Snowbunny
achievement.2.description: Lalalala... sada znaš napamet himnu kulta koja se pjeva u Liberty Bayu. Nije tako teško, s obzirom da se uglavnom sastoji od dvije note i tekstova koji se ponavljaju.
achievement.2.name: Chorister
achievement.20.description: Upoznati ste sa lovačkim zadacima i već ste ih obavili. Pred nama je svijetla karijera lovca na društvo Paw & Fur!
achievement.20.name: Huntsman
achievement.200.description: Zlobne kletve, zla magija - ne bježite od kažnjavanja drugih sumnjivim sredstvima. Neko te je upravo čudno pogledao - gdje je opet ta igla?
achievement.200.name: Dark Voodoo Sveštenik
achievement.201.description: Dom je mjesto gdje je vaše trenutno omiljeno lovište, i iako vam su neka mjesta draža od drugih, nikada se ne osjećate dovoljno vezano da zaista dugo ostanete u jednom gradu. Spakujte sve svoje stvari - vrijeme je da ponovo krenete dalje.
achievement.201.name: Nomad Soul
achievement.202.description: Rekli ste Jacku istinu objašnjavajući da ste vi i Spectulus pogriješili pokušavajući ga uvjeriti da je potpuno druga osoba.
achievement.202.name: Istina se kaže
achievement.203.description: Niste rekli Jacku istinu o grešci koju ste vi i Spectulus napravili kada ste ga pokušavali uvjeriti da je potpuno druga osoba. Živeće u nedoumici do kraja svog postojanja.
achievement.203.name: Ti ne poznaješ Jacka
achievement.204.description: Udruženo čarobno društvo zimske bobice ovime odaje počast kontinuiranoj nesebičnoj posvećenosti i izuzetnim naporima u Godišnjoj jesenskoj berbi.
achievement.204.name: Berry Berry
achievement.205.description: Ti i tvoji prijatelji pokazali ste tri čarobnjaka svoju odanost tri puta - siguran sam da je barem jedan od njih vjerovatno vječno zahvalan i izuzetno ponosan na vas.
achievement.205.name: True Colors
achievement.206.description: Savladali ste Kuriks izazov u svim mogućim oblicima.
achievement.206.name: [EN] Master Shapeshifter
achievement.207.description: Uz pomoć vašeg ljubaznog malog pomoćnika, progutali ste više od 500 komada sluzi. Bravo, Slimer.
achievement.207.name: Slimer
achievement.208.description: Ubio si bijesnog maga u njegovoj kuli južno od Zaoa. Opet. Ali ovaj se samo vraća. Dimenzionalni portal se još jednom srušio i znaš da će se on na kraju vratiti, ali hej - bijesni mag, to je kao da tražiš to...
achievement.208.name: Mageslayer
achievement.209.description: Uhvatili ste pedeset retkih svetlucavih plivača. Riješiti se svih tih leševa bacajući ih u jezero zaista je vrijedilo, zar ne? Čekaj, zar se nešto nije pomaknulo u vodi maloprije...?
achievement.209.name: [EN] Biodegradable
achievement.21.description: Za tebe je poljubac više od jednostavnog dodira usana. Podjednako ljubite djevojke i mrtvace s neusporedivom ljubavlju i suočavate se sa smrću i ponovnim rođenjem kroz poljubac kraljice banshee. Sretni su oni koji podijele tako intiman trenutak sa vama!
achievement.21.name: [EN] Passionate Kisser
achievement.210.description: Nisi to razmatrao - barem ne predugo... ali Groam jeste. I ti si ga oslobodio. Samo nemoj reći njegovom prijatelju Dronku.
achievement.210.name: [EN] Eye of the Deep
achievement.211.description: Mnoga stvorenja dubina su izgubila živote od vaše ruke. Tri stotine je ušlo u dubine večnosti. Vjerovatno biste se trebali bojati osvete Oči dubina.
achievement.211.name: [EN] Invader of the Deep
achievement.212.description: Ugasili ste 500 trnovih požara! Bili ste tamo kada su Firestarteri preuzeli Shadowthorn. Spasili ste dan - i dom nekim vilenjacima koji će vas ipak pokušati ubiti. Nije li lijepo vidjeti da je sve restaurirano kao prije..?
achievement.212.name: [EN] Firefighter
achievement.213.description: Uspeli ste da ubijete više od četiri stotine belih jelena - izgleda da ste vi jedan od glavnih razloga zbog kojih će se oni uskoro smatrati izumrli, tako nešto!
achievement.213.name: Deer Hunt
achievement.214.description: Vi ste sada kraljevski arhidej Askarak-a, ubica princa.
achievement.214.name: [EN] Askarak Nemesis
achievement.215.description: Sada ste javni zakleti neprijatelj Šaburaka, ubice princa.
achievement.215.name: [EN] Shaburak Nemesis
achievement.216.description: Razbio si teglu Horestisa - pedeset puta. Ili ne poznajete strah ili ga jednostavno ignorišete. U svakom slučaju, vi ste zaista "neustrašivi".
achievement.216.name: Neustrašivi
achievement.217.description: Da li je neko zvao doktora? Isporučili ste 100 vrećica s lijekovima Ottokaru iz kuće za siromašne Venore u trenucima teške potrebe, bravo!
achievement.217.name: Doktore! Doktore!
achievement.218.description: Značajno ste pomogli napaćenim građanima Venorea u trenucima teške potrebe. Nekako se još uvijek osjećate blisko sa žrtvama izbijanja groznice. Tvoja te odjeća čini jednim od njih, jednom siromašnom dušom među bezbrojnim pogođenim.
achievement.218.name: [EN] Beak Doctor
achievement.219.description: Pobijedili ste ludog maga, pokorili ste bijesnog maga - nijedan samorazotkrivač čarolija ne može vam stati na put. Ipak, i sami ste prilično zaokupljeni magijskim studijama. Upravo ova tkanina odražava ovo lično odobravanje magijske umjetnosti.
achievement.219.name: [EN] Mystic Fabric Magic
achievement.22.description: Pokazali ste se kao dostojan član 'porodice' i uspješno ste izvršili brojne špijunske misije za svog 'strica' kako biste podržali venorske trgovce i njihove ciljeve.
achievement.22.name: Najbolji AVIN agent
achievement.221.description: Slomio si svaku od osam smrznutih nogu Bloodweba. Kako kažu: slomite nogu, pa još malo.
achievement.221.name: Arachnoise
achievement.222.description: Spustili ste se u močvarne dubine Deathbineove jazbine i brzo se snašli u tome.
achievement.222.name: Rootless Behavior
achievement.223.description: [EN] You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
achievement.223.name: [EN] Twisted Mutation
achievement.224.description: [EN] Ethershreck's cry of agony kept ringing in your ear for hours after he had dissolved into thin air. He probably moved to another plane of existence... for a while.
achievement.224.name: [EN] Beautiful Agony
achievement.225.description: [EN] A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
achievement.225.name: [EN] Scorched Flames
achievement.226.description: [EN] You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
achievement.226.name: [EN] Crawling Death
achievement.227.description: [EN] You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
achievement.227.name: [EN] The Serpent's Bride
achievement.228.description: [EN] You've found a well-hidden spider queen and caught her off guard in the middle of her meal.
achievement.228.name: [EN] No More Hiding
achievement.229.description: [EN] It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
achievement.229.name: [EN] The Gates of Hell
achievement.23.description: Girl power! Bez obzira da li ste žensko ili ne, dokazali ste apsolutnu odanost i spremnost da svoj život stavite na kocku za žensku brigadu Carlin.
achievement.23.name: [EN] Top CGB Agent
achievement.230.description: [EN] As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign.
achievement.230.name: [EN] The Drowned Sea God
achievement.231.description: [EN] Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
achievement.231.name: [EN] Spareribs for Dinner
achievement.232.description: [EN] You almost made friends with Shardhead... before he died. Poor guy only seems to attract violence with his frosty attitude.
achievement.232.name: [EN] Breaking the Ice
achievement.233.description: [EN] Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
achievement.233.name: [EN] Just Cracked Me Up!
achievement.234.description: [EN] You've exinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
achievement.234.name: [EN] Something Smells
achievement.235.description: [EN] You've impaled the big mammoth Bloodtusk with his own tusks.
achievement.235.name: [EN] Meat Skewer
achievement.236.description: [EN] The Many is no more, but how many more are there? One can never know.
achievement.236.name: One Less
achievement.237.description: [EN] You've vanquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.
achievement.237.name: [EN] Hissing Downfall
achievement.238.description: [EN] The Old Widow fell prey to your supreme hunting skills.
achievement.238.name: [EN] Choking on Her Venom
achievement.239.description: [EN] You've tainted the jungle floor with the Snapper's crimson blood.
achievement.239.name: [EN] Blood-Red Snapper
achievement.24.description: Zavere i otvorene tajne su vaš svakodnevni hleb. Pokazali ste lojalnost tajlandskoj kruni svojom hrabrošću kada ste se suočili s neprijateljima i završili špijunske misije. Ti si odličan terenski agent TBI-ja.
achievement.24.name: Najbolji TBI agent
achievement.240.description: [EN] You've cut off a whole lot of tentacles today. Thul was driven back to where he belongs.
achievement.240.name: [EN] Back into the Abyss
achievement.241.description: [EN] You've faced and defeated a lot of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.241.name: [EN] Pwned a Lot of Fur
achievement.242.description: [EN] You've stopped the bank robber and returned the bag full of gold. Good to know there are still lawful Tibians like you around.
achievement.242.name: [EN] Honest Finder
achievement.243.description: [EN] If it wasn't for you, several banks in Tibia would've gotten bankrupt by now. Keep on chasing bank robbers and no one will have to worry about the Tibian economy!
achievement.243.name: Goldhunter
achievement.244.description: [EN] You've discovered a trail of giant footprints and terrified elephants running everywhere. Could it be that the mysterious ape god is rambling in the jungle?
achievement.244.name: [EN] Trail of the Ape God
achievement.245.description: [EN] That was NOT a giant spider. There's some witchcraft at work here.
achievement.245.name: [EN] Someone's Bored
achievement.246.description: [EN] You can't keep a secret, can you? Then again, you're just fulfilling your duty to the Queen of Carlin as a lawful citizen. That's a good thing, isn't it...?
achievement.246.name: [EN] Whistle-Blower
achievement.247.description: [EN] Wyda seems to be really, really bored. You also found out that she doesn't really need all those blood herbs that adventurers brought her. Still, she was nice enough to take one from you and gave you something quite cool in exchange.
achievement.247.name: [EN] Torn Treasures
achievement.248.description: [EN] You joined the Kingsday festivities and payed King Tibianus your respects. Now, off to party!
achievement.248.name: [EN] Loyal Subject
achievement.249.description: [EN] You managed to catch a fish in a surrounding that usually doesn't even carry water. Everything is subject to change, probably...
achievement.249.name: [EN] Desert Fisher
achievement.25.description: Spakujte svoju špijunsku opremu i pripremite se za neke opasne misije u službi tajne agencije. Pokazali ste da želite - ali možete li to zaista učiniti? Vrijeme će pokazati.
achievement.25.name: Tajni agent
achievement.251.description: [EN] You showed Noodles the way home. How long will it take this time until he's on the loose again? That dog must be really bored in the throne room by now.
achievement.251.name: Dog Sitter
achievement.252.description: [EN] You witnessed the thawing of Svargrond and harvested rare seeds from some strange icy plants. They must be good for something.
achievement.252.name: [EN] Ice Harvester
achievement.253.description: [EN] You are a pretty smart thinker and managed to create everlasting flowers. They might become a big hit with all the people who aren't blessed with a green thumb or just forgetful.
achievement.253.name: [EN] Preservationist
achievement.254.description: [EN] You've discovered three nomad camps and stole their supplies. Well, you can probably use them better then they can.
achievement.254.name: [EN] Chest Robber
achievement.255.description: [EN] You've found a secret dungeon in the flooded plains and killed several of its inhabitants. And now you have wet feet.
achievement.255.name: [EN] Down the Drain
achievement.256.description: [EN] You've survived the Hellgorge eruption and found a way through the flames and lava. You've even managed to kill a few fireborn on the way.
achievement.256.name: [EN] Fire from the Earth
achievement.257.description: [EN] Your actions start to make a difference. You have blinded the antennae of the hive often enough to become an annoyance to it.
achievement.257.name: [EN] Minor Disturbance
achievement.258.description: [EN] In the war against the hive, your efforts in blinding it begin to pay off. Your actions have blinded the hive severely and the entity seems to become aware that something dangerous is happening.
achievement.258.name: Dazzler
achievement.259.description: [EN] You have put a lot of time and energy into keeping the hive unaware of what is happening on Quirefang. The hive learnt to fear your actions. It would surely crush you with all its might ... if it could only find you!
achievement.259.name: [EN] Hive Blinder
achievement.26.description: Ti si ambiciozni mago-mehaničar. Nauka i magija dobro funkcioniraju u vašim očima - i iako ste vjerovatno dali bezbroj pogrešnih naboja dok ste radili za Telas, možda imate dovoljno znanja da sada napravite svog golema.
achievement.26.name: Golem u zupčanicima
achievement.260.description: [EN] You have grown accustomed to frequenting the hive's stomach system. Your actions have caused the hive some first digestion problems.
achievement.260.name: Hickup
achievement.261.description: [EN] Never-tiring, you attack the inner organs of the mighty hive. Your attacks on the hive's digestion system begin to cause some trouble.
achievement.261.name: Heartburn
achievement.262.description: [EN] You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
achievement.262.name: [EN] Stomach Ulcer
achievement.263.description: [EN] The hive has to be fought with might and main, hampering its soldiers is only the first step. You diligently stopped the pores of the hive to spread its warriors.
achievement.263.name: Planter
achievement.264.description: [EN] You are getting more and more experienced in destroying the supply of the enemy's forces. Your actions caused the hive some severe skin problems.
achievement.264.name: Pimple
achievement.265.description: [EN] A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
achievement.265.name: Suppressor
achievement.266.description: [EN] By killing creatures of the hive and gaining weapons for further missions, you started a quite effective way of war. You gathered a lot of dissolved chitin to resupply the war effort.
achievement.266.name: Gatherer
achievement.267.description: [EN] The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
achievement.267.name: Supplier
achievement.268.description: [EN] You have become competent and efficient in gathering the substance that is needed to fight the hive. You almost smell like dissolved chitin and the Hive Born would tell their children scary stories about you if they could speak.
achievement.268.name: [EN] Chitin Bane
achievement.269.description: [EN] You have proven that you can beat the best of the hive. You have caused first promising breaches in the defence of the hive
achievement.269.name: [EN] Guard Killer
achievement.27.description: Pjesme, stihovi, pjesme i rime koje ste recitovali mnogo puta. Prošao si kroz tajanstvena vrata, pričao o drevnim predanjima. Čak i vilenjake ste ostavili impresionirani, pa se čini da ste zaista blagoslovljeni.
achievement.27.name: [EN] Poet Laureate
achievement.270.description: [EN] The most powerful warriors of the hive were killed by you by the dozens. The hive is not safe anymore because of your actions.
achievement.270.name: [EN] Hive Infiltrator
achievement.271.description: [EN] Efficient and lethal, you have gained significant experience in fighting the elite forces of the hive. Almost single-handed, you have slain the best of the Hive Born and live to tell the tale.
achievement.271.name: [EN] Exterminator
achievement.272.description: [EN] Even in the deepest structures of the hive, you began to strike against the mighty foe. Your actions probably already gave the hive a headache.
achievement.272.name: Headache
achievement.273.description: [EN] The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
achievement.273.name: Confusion
achievement.274.description: [EN] You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centers and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
achievement.274.name: Manic
achievement.276.name: [EN] Navigational Error
achievement.277.description: [EN] You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
achievement.277.name: Si, Ariki!
achievement.278.description: [EN] You ended the life of over three hundred Deepling Guards. Not quite the guardian of the Deeplings, are you?
achievement.278.name: [EN] Guardian Downfall
achievement.279.description: [EN] You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by sliencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
achievement.279.name: Death Song
achievement.28.description: Možete rukovati bilo kojim muzičkim instrumentom koji vam je dat - i zapravo uspjeti proizvesti prijatan zvuk s njim. Vi ste rado viđen gost i zabavljač u većini taverni.
achievement.28.name: Minstrel
achievement.280.description: [EN] By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
achievement.280.name: [EN] Depth Dwellers
achievement.281.description: [EN] You cut your first gem - and it bears your own name! Now that would be a nice gift! This does not make it a "true" Heart of the Sea, however...
achievement.281.name: Gem Cutter
achievement.282.description: [EN] You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
achievement.282.name: [EN] Spolium Profundis
achievement.283.description: [EN] Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
achievement.283.name: [EN] Bane of the Hive
achievement.285.description: [EN] Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
achievement.285.name: [EN] Hive War Veteran
achievement.286.description: [EN] You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
achievement.286.name: [EN] Hive Fighter
achievement.287.description: [EN] You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
achievement.287.name: [EN] Howly Silence
achievement.288.description: [EN] No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
achievement.288.name: [EN] Dream's Over
achievement.289.description: [EN] You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
achievement.289.name: [EN] Zzztill Zzztanding!
achievement.29.description: Banutu poznajete kao svoj džep i dobri ste u uništavanju kovčega i urni. Pogled na džinovske otiske stopala ne sprečava vas ni da istražujete nepoznata područja.
achievement.29.name: Prijatelj majmuna
achievement.290.description: [EN] This time you knocked out the big one.
achievement.290.name: [EN] Stepped on a Big Toe
achievement.291.description: [EN] No joke, you murdered the bat.
achievement.291.name: Kapow!
achievement.292.description: [EN] You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
achievement.292.name: [EN] Enter zze Draken!
achievement.293.description: [EN] Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
achievement.293.name: [EN] King of the Ring
achievement.294.description: [EN] You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
achievement.294.name: [EN] Back from the Dead
achievement.295.description: [EN] You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.295.name: [EN] Pwned All Fur
achievement.297.description: [EN] You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
achievement.297.name: [EN] Bibby's Bloodbath
achievement.298.description: [EN] You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
achievement.298.name: Nestling
achievement.299.description: [EN] You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
achievement.299.name: [EN] Becoming a Bigfoot
achievement.3.name: [EN] The Milkman
achievement.30.description: Vaša mapa je vaš prijatelj — uvijek u vašem stražnjem džepu i prekrivena bezbrojnim oznakama zanimljivih i korisnih lokacija. Moglo bi se reći da biste mogli biti izgubljeni bez toga - ali na sreću nema načina da vam to oduzmemo.
achievement.30.name: Teritorijalni
achievement.300.description: [EN] You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
achievement.300.name: [EN] Gnome Little Helper
achievement.301.description: [EN] The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
achievement.301.name: [EN] Gnome Friend
achievement.302.description: [EN] You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
achievement.302.name: Gnomelike
achievement.303.description: [EN] You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
achievement.303.name: [EN] Honorary Gnome
achievement.304.description: [EN] You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
achievement.304.name: [EN] Crystals in Love
achievement.305.description: [EN] Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
achievement.305.name: [EN] Substitute Tinker
achievement.306.description: [EN] After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
achievement.306.name: [EN] Spore Hunter
achievement.307.description: [EN] Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
achievement.307.name: [EN] Grinding Again
achievement.308.description: [EN] Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
achievement.308.name: [EN] Dungeon Cleaner
achievement.309.description: [EN] So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
achievement.309.name: [EN] Crystal Keeper
achievement.31.description: Pokazali ste se kao vrijedan saveznik Maridima, a Gabel vam je poželio dobrodošlicu da trgujete s Harounom i Nah'Bob kad god poželite. Iako se Džinski rat još uvijek nije završio, Maridi ne mogu propasti s tobom na njihovoj strani.
achievement.31.name: Marid Ally
achievement.310.description: [EN] Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
achievement.310.name: [EN] Call Me Sparky
achievement.311.description: [EN] One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
achievement.311.name: [EN] One Foot Vs. Many
achievement.312.description: [EN] The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
achievement.312.name: [EN] The Picky Pig
achievement.313.description: [EN] You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
achievement.313.name: [EN] Diplomatic Immunity
achievement.314.description: [EN] Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
achievement.314.name: [EN] Fall of the Fallen
achievement.315.description: [EN] Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
achievement.315.name: [EN] Death on Strike
achievement.316.description: [EN] The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
achievement.316.name: [EN] Death from Below
achievement.317.description: [EN] The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
achievement.317.name: [EN] Gnomebane's Bane
achievement.318.description: [EN] The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
achievement.318.name: [EN] Final Strike
achievement.319.description: [EN] Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
achievement.319.name: [EN] Goo Goo Dancer
achievement.32.description: Iako su vas Efriti dočekali samo nevoljko i gledali na vas kao na "samo čovjeka" već neko vrijeme, uspjeli ste impresionirati Malora i steći njegovo poštovanje i trgovinske mogućnosti sa zelenim džinima.
achievement.32.name: [EN] Efreet Ally
achievement.320.description: [EN] Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
achievement.320.name: [EN] Funghitastic
achievement.321.description: [EN] If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
achievement.321.name: [EN] Crystal Clear
achievement.322.description: [EN] You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
achievement.322.name: [EN] Gnomish Art Of War
achievement.324.description: [EN] You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
achievement.324.name: [EN] True Dedication
achievement.325.description: [EN] Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
achievement.325.name: [EN] Task Manager
achievement.326.description: [EN] Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
achievement.326.name: [EN] Gravedigger
achievement.327.description: [EN] You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
achievement.327.name: Repenter
achievement.328.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.328.name: [EN] Umbral Swordsman
achievement.33.description: Dreams - are your reality? Čudne vizije, otkucaji sati, odlazak u krevet i buđenje na nekom drugom mjestu - to je bilo neko putovanje, ali gotovo ste sigurni da ste zaista uživali.
achievement.33.name: [EN] Lucid Dreamer
achievement.331.description: [EN] You have helped the gnomes of the spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightles depths to earn you a complete cave explorers outfit. Well done!
achievement.331.name: [EN] Cave Completionist
achievement.332.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.332.name: [EN] Umbral Bladelord
achievement.333.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.333.name: [EN] Umbral Headsman
achievement.334.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.334.name: [EN] Umbral Executioner
achievement.335.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.335.name: [EN] Umbral Brawler
achievement.336.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.336.name: [EN] Umbral Berserker
achievement.337.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.337.name: [EN] Umbral Archer
achievement.338.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.338.name: [EN] Umbral Marksman
achievement.339.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.339.name: [EN] Umbral Harbinger
achievement.34.description: Bili ste na mjestima čija većina ljudi ne zna ni imena. Prikupljanje botaničkih, zooloških i ektoplazmatskih uzoraka vaš je svakodnevni posao i uvijek ste spremni za otkrivanje novih horizonata.
achievement.34.name: Explorer
achievement.340.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
achievement.340.name: [EN] Umbral Master
achievement.341.description: [EN] You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
achievement.341.name: [EN] Nevermending Story
achievement.342.description: [EN] What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
achievement.342.name: [EN] Luring Silence
achievement.343.description: [EN] You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
achievement.343.name: [EN] Never Surrender
achievement.344.description: [EN] You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
achievement.344.name: [EN] Dream Wright
achievement.345.description: [EN] You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
achievement.345.name: [EN] Ending the Horror
achievement.346.description: [EN] You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
achievement.346.name: [EN] Sleepwalking
achievement.347.description: [EN] It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
achievement.347.name: [EN] Dream Warden
achievement.348.description: [EN] Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
achievement.348.name: [EN] Prison Break
achievement.349.description: [EN] After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
achievement.349.name: [EN] Noblesse Obliterated
achievement.35.description: Čak vas ni neprijateljsko podvodno okruženje ne sprečava da izvršite svoju dužnost za Društvo istraživača. Izviđanje u carstvu Quara je pravi komad za vas.
achievement.35.name: Sea Scout
achievement.350.description: [EN] Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
achievement.350.name: [EN] Elementary, My Dear
achievement.351.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Commoner.
achievement.351.name: [EN] Rathleton Commoner
achievement.352.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Inhabitant.
achievement.352.name: [EN] Rathleton Inhabitant
achievement.353.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Citizen.
achievement.353.name: [EN] Rathleton Citizen
achievement.354.description: [EN] You accomplished 10 or more consecutive chains in a row! That's killing at least 39 creatures in the correct order - now that's combinatorics!
achievement.354.name: [EN] Combo Master
achievement.355.description: [EN] Though you might have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shagron.
achievement.355.name: [EN] Glooth Engineer
achievement.356.description: [EN] You discovered the Lion's Rock, passed the tests to enter the inner sanctum and finally revealed the secrets of the buried temple. You literally put your head in the lion's mouth and survived.
achievement.356.name: [EN] Lion's Den Explorer
achievement.357.description: [EN] Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
achievement.357.name: [EN] Seasoned Adventurer
achievement.358.description: [EN] You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
achievement.358.name: [EN] Mind the Step!
achievement.359.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Squire.
achievement.359.name: [EN] Rathleton Squire
achievement.36.description: Vau - šta je to bilo? Ne znaš kako si završio ovdje, ali nekako jesi. Kako doći od Beregara do Kazordoona za tren - to je nešto što bi ti patuljci voljeli znati, ali niste baš sigurni kako to reproducirati.
achievement.36.name: Malo vjerovatno Pathfinder
achievement.360.description: [EN] He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
achievement.360.name: [EN] The Professor's Nut
achievement.361.description: [EN] You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
achievement.361.name: [EN] Plant vs. Minos
achievement.362.description: [EN] You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait.
achievement.362.name: [EN] Rumble in the Plant
achievement.363.description: [EN] You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
achievement.363.name: Robo Chop
achievement.364.description: [EN] You escaped the glowing hot lava death trap, Professor Maxxen has set for you - Captain Caveworm is indeed proud!
achievement.364.name: [EN] Go with da Lava Flow
achievement.365.description: [EN] You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
achievement.365.name: [EN] Wail of the Banshee
achievement.366.description: [EN] You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
achievement.366.name: Publicity
achievement.367.description: [EN] By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
achievement.367.name: [EN] Snake Charmer
achievement.368.description: [EN] Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
achievement.368.name: [EN] Hoard of the Dragon
achievement.37.description: Topao, krznen i umiljat - iako bi vas taj isti medvjedić kojeg ste upravo zagrlili vjerovatno raskomadao u komade da je bio pri svijesti, podsjetio vas je na onog starog plišanog medvjedića koji je uvijek spavao u vašem krevetu dok ste još bili mali.
achievement.37.name: Bearhugger
achievement.370.description: [EN] You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
achievement.370.name: [EN] Little Ball of Wool
achievement.371.description: [EN] You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
achievement.371.name: [EN] Luminous Kitty
achievement.372.description: [EN] By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
achievement.372.name: [EN] The Right Tone
achievement.373.description: [EN] Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn...
achievement.373.name: Loyal Lad
achievement.374.description: [EN] It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
achievement.374.name: [EN] Dragon Mimicry
achievement.375.description: [EN] The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
achievement.375.name: [EN] Scales and Tail
achievement.376.description: [EN] There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
achievement.376.name: [EN] Fata Morgana
achievement.377.description: [EN] Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
achievement.377.name: [EN] Fabled Construction
achievement.378.description: [EN] Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
achievement.378.name: [EN] Mind the Dog!
achievement.379.description: [EN] This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
achievement.379.name: Magnetised
achievement.38.description: Ne lovite ih, razgovarate s njima. Znate da duhovi mogu čuvati tajne koje su dugo bile izgubljene među živima, i vješti ste da ih nagovorite da vam ih otkriju.
achievement.38.name: [EN] Ghostwhisperer
achievement.380.description: [EN] Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
achievement.380.name: [EN] Golden Sands
achievement.381.description: [EN] Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
achievement.381.name: [EN] Friend of Elves
achievement.382.description: [EN] Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
achievement.382.name: [EN] Lovely Dots
achievement.383.description: [EN] This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
achievement.383.name: [EN] Way to Hell
achievement.384.description: [EN] Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
achievement.384.name: [EN] Beneath the Sea
achievement.385.description: [EN] By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
achievement.385.name: [EN] Starless Night
achievement.386.description: [EN] By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
achievement.386.name: Lion King
achievement.387.description: [EN] Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
achievement.387.name: [EN] Pecking Order
achievement.388.description: [EN] Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
achievement.388.name: Pig-Headed
achievement.389.description: [EN] It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
achievement.389.name: [EN] Personal Nightmare
achievement.39.description: Ne volite male, slabe životinje i činite sve što je u vašoj moći da ih zaštitite - čak i ako vjerojatno jedete zmajeve za doručak.
achievement.39.name: [EN] Animal Activist
achievement.390.description: [EN] It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
achievement.390.name: [EN] Thick-Skinned
achievement.391.description: [EN] Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
achievement.391.name: [EN] Chequered Teddy
achievement.392.description: [EN] Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
achievement.392.name: [EN] Blacknailed
achievement.393.description: [EN] Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
achievement.393.name: [EN] Slugging Around
achievement.394.description: [EN] It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
achievement.394.name: [EN] Knock on Wood
achievement.395.description: [EN] This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
achievement.395.name: [EN] Fried Shrimp
achievement.396.description: [EN] What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
achievement.396.name: [EN] Out of the Stone Age
achievement.397.description: [EN] A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
achievement.397.name: Stuntman
achievement.398.description: [EN] Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
achievement.398.name: Gear Up
achievement.399.description: [EN] Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
achievement.399.name: [EN] Bearbaiting
achievement.4.description: Uvek si bio buntovnik - priznaj! Snabdijevanje zatvorenika, briga o izopćenicima, krađa od bogatih i davanje siromašnima - ne čekajte, to je bila druga priča.
achievement.4.name: [EN] Vive la Resistance
achievement.40.description: Grlili ste medvjede, gurali mamute i dokazali svoje vještine pijenja. I iako imate blagi mamurluk, djelimično slomljeno rebro i nešto masne dlake na jeziku, prilično ste ponosni što se od sada nazivate počasnim varvarinom.
achievement.40.name: Počasni varvarin
achievement.400.description: [EN] 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
achievement.400.name: [EN] Lucky Horseshoe
achievement.401.description: [EN] By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
achievement.401.name: [EN] Swamp Beast
achievement.402.description: [EN] Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
achievement.402.name: Spin-Off
achievement.403.description: [EN] Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
achievement.403.name: Icy Glare
achievement.404.description: [EN] You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
achievement.404.name: [EN] Cartography 101
achievement.405.description: [EN] Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
achievement.405.name: [EN] Lost Palace Raider
achievement.406.description: [EN] It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
achievement.406.name: [EN] The More the Merrier
achievement.408.description: [EN] You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
achievement.408.name: [EN] Rift Warrior
achievement.41.description: Vi ste taj koji ovde postavlja pitanja i znate kako da dobijete odgovore koje želite da čujete. Osim toga, ti si poznati egzorcista i tu i tamo ubiješ nekoliko vampira i demona. Vi i vaš ulog ste savršen tim.
achievement.41.name: Visoki inkvizitor
achievement.410.description: [EN] You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! – You weren't there for the hat only after all?
achievement.410.name: Hat Hunter
achievement.411.description: [EN] You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
achievement.411.name: Ogre Chef
achievement.412.description: [EN] You opposed man-eating ogres and clumsy clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
achievement.412.name: [EN] The Call of the Wild
achievement.413.description: [EN] You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world — at least for a while.
achievement.413.name: [EN] Ender of the End
achievement.414.description: [EN] After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
achievement.414.name: [EN] Vortex Tamer
achievement.415.description: [EN] Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
achievement.415.name: [EN] Rhino Rider
achievement.416.description: [EN] You could not resist the taste of the forbidden fruit. Since you don't feel changed at all, it couldn't have been that bad after all. Or could it?
achievement.416.name: [EN] Forbidden Fruit
achievement.417.description: [EN] Perhaps with so much acquired knowledge, never meant for you, you know even when to stop! Time will tell whether this knowledge will do more harm or good.
achievement.417.name: [EN] Forbidden Knowledge
achievement.418.description: [EN] You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
achievement.418.name: [EN] Treasure Hunter
achievement.419.description: [EN] You met the legendary First Dragon and survived. That's a reason to celebrate for sure.
achievement.419.name: [EN] Reason to Celebrate
achievement.42.description: Weehee! Udari te crve! Sigurno znate kako da rukujete velikim čekićem.
achievement.42.name: [EN] Worm Whacker
achievement.420.description: [EN] You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
achievement.420.name: [EN] Toothfairy Assistant
achievement.421.description: [EN] Teasing fairies is fun. They leave behind such pretty clouds of glittering dust when chased. Just hope they don't get you back for it.
achievement.421.name: [EN] Fairy Teasing
achievement.422.description: [EN] You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
achievement.422.name: [EN] Corruption Contained
achievement.43.description: Niste sigurni šta je to, ali osećate da vas privlači kraljevska porodica. Koljena su vam uvijek malo nagrizena od puzanja ispred prijestolja i volite se družiti u dvorcima. Možda biste trebali razmisliti o prijavi kao čuvar?
achievement.43.name: Kralj Tibianus Fan
achievement.430.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 10 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.430.name: [EN] Little Adventure
achievement.431.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 100 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.431.name: [EN] Little Big Adventure
achievement.432.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.432.name: Contender
achievement.433.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.433.name: [EN] Serious Contender
achievement.434.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.434.name: [EN] Skilled Hunter
achievement.435.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 100 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.435.name: [EN] Master Hunter
achievement.436.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
achievement.436.name: [EN] Hunting Permit
achievement.437.description: [EN] The Curse of the Full Moon transforms harmless citizens into feral beasts. But with your help, Edron and Cormaya are safe - fairly.
achievement.437.name: [EN] Over the Moon
achievement.438.description: [EN] You defeated the Count of the Core and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.438.name: [EN] His Days are Counted
achievement.439.description: [EN] You defeated the Duke of the Depths and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.439.name: [EN] Duked It Out
achievement.44.description: Vi ste brzi trkač i dobri ste u isporuci robe koja će se u tren oka propasti, čak i ako ne možete koristiti nikakvo prijevozno sredstvo ili ako vam se ruke ohlade ili smrde u tom procesu.
achievement.44.name: Samo na vrijeme
achievement.440.description: [EN] You defeated the Baron from Below and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.440.name: [EN] Buried the Baron
